claim: No HWA 10.2.8, o localopts do MDM controla: batchman (`bm check file` 120s, `bm check status` 300s, `bm look` 5min), jobman (`jm job table size` 1024, `jm no root yes` — jobs nunca rodam como root), mailman (`mm response` 600s, `mm retrylink` 600s, `mm unlink` 960s) e netman (`nm port` 31111, `nm SSL full port` 31113). O globalopts define company=LAB, master=MDM, start=0000 (meia-noite).
